title: Colour and light
about: Collocations for describing colours (bright colours, pale blue, the colour runs, colours clash) and light (pitch dark, a faint glow, stars twinkle), plus metaphors with colour and light such as a grey area, shed light on sth and cast a shadow over sth.

items.pattern: bright colours · bright + colour: bright yellow, bright red, bright green · opposite: subdued / dull colours
items.meaning: strong, vivid colours that catch your eye
items.example: The children's ward at the hospital is painted in **bright colours** to cheer the kids up.
more: I've bought a **bright red** umbrella for the gloomy winter days.
The market stalls were piled high with fruit and vegetables in **bright colours**.
items.watchOut: Яскравий — bright, а світлий — light або pale: light blue — світло-блакитний, а не яскраво-синій. «Яскраво-жовтий» — bright yellow, без -ly. Надто яскраві, аж «кричущі» кольори — loud або garish colours.

items.pattern: subdued / muted / soft colours · opposite: bright colours · dull colours — тьмяні, нудні
items.meaning: quiet colours that are not very bright
items.example: The hotel rooms are decorated in **subdued colours**: beige, soft grey and olive green.
more: The new shop sells winter coats in **subdued colours** like brown and charcoal.
My grandad only ever wears **subdued colours**, never anything bright.
items.watchOut: Про людину subdued — притихлий, пригнічений (She seemed subdued after the news). Про кольори — стримані, неяскраві, і це звучить нейтрально. Dull colours — тьмяні, нудні: це вже критика.

items.pattern: pale / light + colour: pale blue, pale pink, light green · opposite: dark / deep
items.meaning: a soft colour with a lot of white in it, not bright or strong
items.example: We painted the bathroom **pale blue**, and now it feels like a seaside hotel.
more: She wore a **pale yellow** dress to her sister's garden party.
I'd like a **light green** shirt to wear with my brown trousers.
items.watchOut: Окремого слова для «блакитний» в англійській немає: кажуть light blue, pale blue або sky blue. Просто blue — це і синій, і блакитний.

items.pattern: dark / deep + colour: dark green, dark blue, deep red · opposite: pale / light
items.meaning: a strong colour that is close to black
items.example: Our front door is **dark green**, with a shiny brass number on it.
more: He wore a **dark blue** suit to his brother's wedding.
Her new winter coat is a lovely **deep red**.

items.pattern: the colour fades (in the wash / in the sun) · sth fades · faded jeans
items.meaning: the colour slowly becomes paler and less bright
items.example: Wash dark clothes inside out, so the **colour** doesn't **fade** so fast.
more: My favourite jeans have **faded** at the knees.
The paint on the garden fence has **faded** after three hot summers.
items.watchOut: Fade — колір поступово блякне (від прання чи сонця). Run — фарба виходить під час прання і фарбує інші речі. Українське «линяти» може означати і те, і те, тож подумай, що саме сталося.

items.pattern: the colour runs (in the wash) · colours may run · run – ran – run
items.meaning: dye comes out of a piece of clothing in the wash and stains other things
items.example: I washed my son's new blue football shirt with the white sheets, the **colour ran**, and now the sheets are pale blue.
more: Cheap black T-shirts often **run** the first time you wash them.
Wash this silk scarf in cold water, or the **colours** might **run**.
items.watchOut: Про одяг «фарба» — colour або dye, а не paint (paint — фарба для стін і картин). Тому the colour ran, а не the paint ran. Run тут не «бігти», а «розтікатися».

items.pattern: A goes (well) with B · A and B go (well) together · go – went – gone
items.meaning: look good next to each other
items.example: Your grey scarf **goes well with** that red coat.
more: Do you think these cushions **go with** the new sofa?
Navy and white always **go well together**.
items.watchOut: «Пасує до сукні» — goes with the dress, без to. Suit — коли щось пасує людині: That colour suits you. Fit — підходить за розміром: These shoes don't fit me.

items.pattern: colours clash · A clashes with B · a clash of colours
items.meaning: colours look bad or ugly together
items.example: I love that orange top, but it **clashes with** your pink skirt.
more: The **colours** on the football team's new kit really **clash**.
Don't paint the kitchen bright red: it'll **clash with** the green tiles.
items.watchOut: «Ці кольори не пасують» — коротко: these colours clash. Після clash — with: the bag clashes with the coat, не clashes to the coat.

items.pattern: A matches B · sth to match (a hat to match) · matching (a matching bag)
items.meaning: have the same or a very similar colour, so they look right together
items.uk: пасувати в тон; бути такого самого кольору
items.example: The new cushions **match** the curtains perfectly: they're exactly the same green.
more: She always wears earrings that **match** her dress.
We're looking for a chair to **match** the one we bought last year.
items.watchOut: Match — однаковий колір або в тон. Go with — просто гарно поєднуються, навіть різні кольори. Після match зазвичай немає прийменника: match the curtains, не match to the curtains.

items.pattern: add / give / bring a touch of colour (to sth) · also a splash of colour
items.meaning: a small amount of colour that makes something look brighter
items.example: A bunch of tulips on the table added **a touch of colour** to the kitchen.
more: She wears a yellow scarf to give **a touch of colour** to her dark winter coat.
Pots of geraniums on the balconies bring **a touch of colour** to the street.
items.watchOut: «Трохи кольору» — a touch (a bit, a splash) of colour, а не a piece of colour: piece — шматок чогось.

items.pattern: it's growing dark · it had grown dark (written) · it's getting dark (everyday)
items.meaning: become dark slowly as evening comes
items.example: It was **growing dark**, so we packed up the picnic and headed home.
more: In December it **gets dark** before five o'clock.
By the end of the match it had **grown dark**, and the floodlights came on.
items.watchOut: «Темніє» — it's getting dark (у розмові) або it's growing dark (у книжці). Darken частіше кажуть про небо чи кімнату (the sky darkened), а не як звичайне «сутеніє».

items.pattern: a candle / a flame / the lights flicker · a flickering candle
items.meaning: the light burns unsteadily, getting brighter and weaker
items.example: The **candle flickered** every time someone opened the door.
more: We had dinner on the terrace by the light of a **flickering** candle.
The kitchen light **flickers** when the washing machine is on.
items.watchOut: Українське «мерехтить» — це і flicker, і twinkle. Flicker — нерівне, тремтливе світло свічки, вогню, лампи. Twinkle — так блимають зорі чи далекі вогні.

items.pattern: a (powerful / narrow) beam of light · a torch beam · the beam of the headlights
items.meaning: a strong line of light from a torch, a lamp, a lighthouse or car headlights
items.uk: промінь, сноп світла (від ліхтарика, фар, маяка)
items.example: The torch sent a powerful **beam of light** across the dark garden.
more: A narrow **beam of light** from the projector lit up the cinema screen.
Every few seconds the **beam** of the lighthouse swept across the bay.
items.watchOut: Beam — найчастіше промінь від ліхтарика, фар, маяка. Про сонце частіше кажуть a ray of sunlight (хоча sunbeam теж є). «Дальнє світло фар» — full beam (UK) або high beams (US).

items.pattern: a ray of sunlight / sun / light · the first / last rays of the sun
items.meaning: a narrow line of light from the sun
items.example: The cat was asleep on the kitchen floor in **a ray of sunlight**.
more: After a week of rain, the first **rays of sunlight** felt wonderful.
We finished our picnic in the last **rays of the sun**.

items.pattern: the glare of the sun / the headlights · the sun's glare · glare at sb — сердито дивитися
items.meaning: very strong, bright light that hurts your eyes
items.example: **The glare of the sun** on the windscreen made it hard to see the road.
more: The café has blinds to protect customers from **the glare of the** afternoon **sun**.
**The glare** of oncoming headlights is the worst thing about driving at night.
items.watchOut: Не плутай glare і glow: glare — різке, сліпуче світло, від якого мружишся; glow — м'яке, тепле світіння. Дієслово glare at sb — сердито дивитися на когось.

items.pattern: pitch dark / pitch black (a night, a room, outside) · compare: jet black (hair)
items.meaning: completely dark, with no light at all
items.uk: темно, хоч в око стрель; непроглядна темрява
items.example: When the lights went out, the hotel corridor was **pitch dark**.
more: There are no street lights in the village, so it's **pitch black** at night.
I woke up at three in the morning, and the room was **pitch dark**.
items.watchOut: Pitch dark / pitch black — про темряву: ніч, кімнату, вулицю. Про дуже чорне волосся кажуть jet black, а не pitch black.

items.pattern: a faint / soft / warm glow · the glow of dawn / a fire / a lamp
items.meaning: a weak, soft light, often far away
items.example: Through the curtains came **the faint glow** of the street lamp outside.
more: There was still **a faint glow** in the ashes of the campfire.
Before sunrise, **a faint glow** of dawn appeared behind the hills.
items.watchOut: Faint — ледь помітний: так кажуть про світло, запах, звук (a faint glow, a faint smell, a faint sound). Не плутай з дієсловом faint — знепритомніти.

items.pattern: be tinged with + colour (gold, pink, red) · also about feelings: tinged with sadness · a tinge of pink
items.meaning: having a slight amount of a colour (or of a feeling)
items.example: At sunset the snow on the mountains was **tinged with gold**.
more: By late August the leaves on the birch trees were already **tinged with yellow**.
Our goodbye at the airport was **tinged with sadness**.
items.watchOut: Після tinged зазвичай with: tinged with gold, не tinged of gold. А після іменника tinge — of: a tinge of pink, a tinge of regret.

items.pattern: stars / lights twinkle · twinkling lights · compare: the sun shines
items.meaning: shine with a small light that seems to flash on and off
items.example: We lay on the grass and watched the **stars twinkling** above us.
more: The lights of the village **twinkled** on the other side of the lake.
Her eyes **twinkled** when she told us the joke.
items.watchOut: Про зорі кажуть twinkle (мерехтять) або shine (світять). Blink — це кліпати очима, про зорі так кажуть хіба у віршах.

items.pattern: a (tiny) pinpoint of light (in the distance / in the dark)
items.meaning: a very small spot of light, usually far away
items.example: Far out at sea, we could see **a pinpoint of light** from a fishing boat.
more: At the end of the long tunnel there was just **a pinpoint of light**.
The satellite looked like **a pinpoint of light** moving slowly across the sky.

items.pattern: a grey area · be (a bit of) a grey area · US spelling: gray
items.meaning: a situation where the rules are not clear, so it's hard to say what is right or allowed
items.example: Who pays for a broken boiler, the landlord or the tenant, is **a grey area** in our contract.
more: Taking a day off when your child is ill is **a grey area** at my company.
How much parents should help with homework is a bit of **a grey area**.
items.watchOut: «Сіра зона» як місце між лініями фронту — grey zone. А питання, де правила нечіткі й незрозуміло, що можна, а що ні, — a grey area.

items.pattern: add colour to sth (your life, a story, a town) · also bring colour to sth
items.meaning: make something more interesting, lively or exciting
items.uk: додавати барв чомусь, робити цікавішим, жвавішим
items.example: Our new neighbours, with their parrots and noisy parties, have **added colour to** a very quiet street.
more: Grandad's funny stories **add colour to** every family dinner.
Joining a dance class really **added colour to** my long winter evenings.
items.watchOut: Дієслово colour sth у переносному значенні — «впливати, спотворювати»: His bad experience coloured his opinion. «Додати барв життю» — add colour to your life.

items.pattern: green issues · also green policies, go green, the Green Party
items.meaning: questions about protecting the environment
items.example: At school, my son learns about **green issues** such as saving water and energy.
more: My sister cares about **green issues**, so she never buys bottled water.
More and more shoppers think about **green issues** when they choose a brand.
items.watchOut: «Екологічні питання» — green issues або environmental issues; ecological issues звучить науково. Issue тут — питання, проблема, а не «випуск» журналу.

items.pattern: blacken sb's name / reputation · try to blacken sb's name
items.meaning: say bad, often untrue things about someone to damage their reputation
items.example: A jealous colleague tried to **blacken her name** by telling lies to the boss.
more: A story in the local paper **blackened** the builder's **name**, but none of it was true.
He's angry with his neighbour for **blackening his name** all over the village.
items.watchOut: «Очорнити людину» — blacken sb's name: чорніє ім'я, а не людина. Blacken sb без name звучить буквально — зробити когось чорним (від сажі чи бруду).

items.pattern: shed / throw (some / new) light on sth · shed – shed – shed · throw – threw – thrown
items.meaning: help to explain something or make it clearer
items.example: Maybe the neighbours can **shed some light on** why the shop closed so suddenly.
more: The hotel manager couldn't **throw any light on** how my suitcase had disappeared.
A new study **sheds light on** why some children refuse to eat vegetables.
items.watchOut: «Пролити світло» — не pour і не spill light: кажуть shed або throw light on sth. Shed не змінюється: shed – shed – shed.

items.pattern: cast a shadow over / on sth (a party, a holiday, sb's life) · cast – cast – cast
items.meaning: make a happy event or time less happy
items.example: A row between the two brothers **cast a shadow over** Mum's birthday party.
more: News of the airport strike **cast a shadow over** the last days of our holiday.
Money worries **cast a shadow over** their first year of marriage.
items.watchOut: «Затьмарити свято» — cast a shadow over (або on) sth, з дієсловом cast, а не put чи make. Cast не змінюється: cast – cast – cast.

items.pattern: be / live / grow up under (in) the shadow of sb · in sb's shadow
items.meaning: get less attention than someone because they are more successful or famous
items.example: The singer's daughter spent years **under the shadow of** her famous mother before she found her own style.
more: Our little football club has always been **in the shadow of** the big city team.
Sam always felt he was living **in** his older brother's **shadow**.
items.watchOut: «Бути в тіні когось» — in sb's shadow або under / in the shadow of sb. Не shade: shade — тінь, у якій ховаються від сонця (Let's sit in the shade).

warmup.explain: Яскравий — bright. Light colours — світлі, бліді кольори, а shining про кольори не кажуть.

warmup.uk: Я випрала нові джинси разом із білими речами, і фарба полиняла.
warmup.q: I washed my new jeans with my white things, and the colour ___.
warmup.explain: Фарба полиняла на інші речі — the colour ran. Run тут не «бігти», а «розтікатися».

warmup.uk: Ця сумка пасує до твоїх черевиків.
warmup.explain: Пасує до чогось — goes with, без to. Suit — коли щось пасує людині: Red suits you.
Кольори, які погано виглядають разом, — clash. Connect і unite — про з'єднання, а не про кольори.

warmup.uk: Надворі темно, хоч в око стрель.
warmup.explain: Повна темрява — pitch dark або pitch black. Jet black кажуть про дуже чорне волосся.

warmup.uk: Може, ти проллєш світло на цю загадку?
warmup.q: Can you ___ some light on this mystery?
warmup.explain: Пролити світло на щось — shed (або throw) light on sth. Pour і spill — про рідину.

warmup.q: The bad news ___ a shadow over our celebration.
warmup.explain: Затьмарити, кинути тінь — cast a shadow over sth. Cast – cast – cast.

warmup.uk: Він завжди був у тіні свого старшого брата.
warmup.q: He has always been in the ___ of his older brother.
warmup.explain: Бути в тіні когось — in the shadow of sb. Shade — тінь, де ховаються від сонця.

A.q: This sofa used to be dark red, but it has ___ to a dusty pink.
A.explain: Fade — колір поступово блякне. Clash — кольори не пасують, match — збігаються за кольором.

A.q: That purple bag ___ with your orange coat. Take the black one.
A.explain: Clash with — погано виглядати поруч. Порада взяти іншу сумку показує, що кольори не пасують.

A.q: Those green earrings ___ really well with your red hair.
A.explain: Go (well) with — річ пасує до іншої речі чи кольору. Suit — пасує людині (Green suits you), і with після нього не ставлять.

B.q: We couldn't see a thing: the cellar was ___ dark.
B.explain: Pitch dark — повна темрява. Jet black — про дуже чорне волосся.

B.q: Close the curtains, please: the ___ of the sun on the TV screen is hurting my eyes.
B.explain: Glare — різке, сліпуче світло. Glow — м'яке світіння, pinpoint — крихітна світла цятка.

B.q: For a moment, a ___ of sunlight broke through the clouds.
B.explain: Сонячний промінь — a ray of sunlight.

C.q: Nobody knows if you can bring your own food into the cinema. It's a ___ area.
C.explain: A grey area — питання, де правила нечіткі, «сіра зона».

C.q: Why are you telling everyone those lies? Are you trying to ___ my name?
C.explain: Blacken sb's name — очорнити когось, зіпсувати репутацію.

C.q: This old diary might ___ some light on why our family moved to Canada.
C.explain: Пролити світло — throw або shed light on sth. Pour — лити рідину.

example.title: A weekend by the lake
example.uk:
Ми дісталися озера, коли вже сутеніло. Поки поставили намет, стало темно, хоч в око стрель, тож вечеряли при тремтливому вогнику свічки. Над нами мерехтіли тисячі зірок, а вдалині було видно ледь помітне світіння якогось містечка.

Вранці в намет прокрався сонячний промінь, а озеро надворі мало легкий золотавий відтінок. Я вдягла яскраво-жовту футболку, яка жахливо не пасувала до братових фіолетових шортів, і ми побігли до води.

Ті вихідні справді додали барв нашому сірому літу. Лише одне пішло не так: удома я випрала наш новий червоний пляжний рушник разом із татовими білими сорочками, і він полиняв. Тепер у тата три рожеві сорочки.

We reached the lake just as it was [[growing dark|b1]]. By the time the tent was up, it was [[pitch dark|b6]], so we ate our supper by a [[flickering|b2]] candle. Above us, thousands of [[stars twinkled|b9]], and far away we could see [[the faint glow|b7]] of a town.

In the morning, [[a ray of sunlight|b4]] crept into the tent, and the lake outside was [[tinged with gold|b8]]. I put on my [[bright yellow|a1]] T-shirt, which [[clashed|a8]] terribly with my brother's purple shorts, and we ran down to the water.

That weekend really [[added colour to|c2]] our grey summer. Only one thing went wrong: back home, I washed our new red beach towel with Dad's white shirts, and [[the colour ran|a6]]. Now he has three pink shirts.
